name: reading_level_tracker
description: Welcome to the Reading Development Web Application! This platform helps students track and improve their reading level.

scripts.dev: [ -f frontend/package.json ] && (cd frontend && npm run dev) || echo "No frontend dev script (frontend/package.json missing)"
scripts.build: [ -f frontend/package.json ] && (cd frontend && npm run build) || echo "No frontend build (frontend/package.json missing)"
scripts.preview: [ -f frontend/package.json ] && (cd frontend && npm run preview) || echo "No frontend preview (frontend/package.json missing)"
